                          ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICA GO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District symbols

and indications as shown on Map No. 2-1 in the area bounded by


       a line 200 feet north of and parallel to West Hamson Street;
       South California Avenue; West Harrison Street; and the alley
       next west ofand parallel to South Califomia Avenue,


to those of a C l - l Neighborhood Commercial District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.
